name: serve_vx2_plunger_held
description: Ball 0 below the drain line with the plunger held from frame 0: EP5 serves at (297,346) with vx=2 (cs:0753). The lane block runs the plunger code during the serve delay except when it reaches 1 (cs:0834..0844); while the plunger is held (cs:08B5 charge += 12) nothing clears vx, so vx=2 drives the x accumulator until the release (cs:08E4 vx=0). A player holding the plunger when the ball arrives sees this.
